goal: A thesis author can run offline validation and receive complete, deterministic document and template diagnostics with stable exit behavior.
non_goals: Do not parse BibTeX records or validate individual citation keys before task 006.
Do not apply template styles in Compiler or DOCX Renderer before task 003.
Do not add UI, network, persistent storage, account or AI dependencies.
expected_evidence: Red and green focused validator, template and CLI tests
Task report, independent spec review and independent quality review
unsafe_assumptions: A Front Matter template ID does not prove that a matching local YAML exists.
Template ID lookup must not change with process cwd.
Local image and bibliography paths must remain inside the configured resource root.
Warning diagnostics must not be treated as fatal.
Citation-key validation cannot be claimed until task 006 loads BibTeX.
Template lengths without supported units must not be normalized silently.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation would cross Parser/Domain architecture boundaries, require bibliography parsing owned by task 006, or edit outside the allowed files.
